subject: executor: improve parallel hash aggregation (#47428)
summary: Reviewed this commit relative to its first parent, focusing on `pkg/executor/aggregate` parallel HashAgg. The change shards partial results per final worker (per-partial-worker maps) and merges maps directly in final workers, and fixes `GetGroupKey` to return `groupKey[:numRows]` to avoid stale tail keys affecting aggregation. No Blocker/High issues found in correctness/SQL semantics, concurrency/channel lifecycle, or session/runtime handling; later history up to `upstream/master` keeps the same core approach (refactored further for spill), with no revert/fix suggesting a regression in this commit.
